What

What Bulk Firewood Delivery Involves

Bulk firewood is our full-cord and multi-cord delivery service for households and properties that burn a lot of wood. A full cord measures 4 ft × 4 ft × 8 ft — 128 cubic feet — the largest standard unit, and multi-cord deliveries are routine. Every bulk order is the same locally sourced, seasoned hardwood we deliver by the face cord: bucked and split from Roubic's own NE Ohio tree work, seasoned 6–12 months on the Auburn Township yard, and moisture-tested under 20% before delivery.

The distinction that matters: bulk means volume, and volume earns a better per-cord rate — typically a 10–20% discount per full cord on multi-cord orders. We dump the load in the location you designate, or stack it for an added charge. It's the practical choice for anyone laying in a full winter's supply or building a multi-year wood stock.

Why

Four Reasons NE Ohio Homes Order Bulk

The most common bulk-firewood situations we deliver into across NE Ohio.

Primary Wood Heat

Homes heating primarily with wood burn 3–6 cords a winter. Bulk delivery keeps the rack full without repeat trips.

Rural & Multi-Acre Properties

Multi-acre lots with wood stoves or outdoor furnaces need cords, not bundles. We deliver where the driveway allows.

Agricultural Operations

Farms using wood for outdoor heaters or processing order in bulk. Geauga County operations are regular customers.

Multi-Year Wood Supply

Buy now, season further, burn next year. Bulk lets you build a stock and lock in today's volume pricing.

Common Bulk Firewood Questions

Bulk Firewood FAQ

Five things NE Ohio wood-heat customers ask before ordering.

How much is a full cord of firewood delivered in NE Ohio?
Pricing is delivery-distance and volume sensitive. Multi-cord orders qualify for a 10–20% discount per cord under our face-cord rates. Call {{global.phone}} for current per-cord pricing to your specific address.
How much firewood do I need for a winter?
Primary wood heat runs 3–6 cords per winter for a typical NE Ohio home. Supplemental heat — weekend fires or occasional use — runs 1–2 cords. Heavy fireplace use most evenings is about 2–3 cords.
Can I order multiple cords at once?
Yes — multi-cord deliveries are routine and qualify for a volume discount. Recurring annual pre-season delivery programs are available for committed wood-heat customers, and we prioritize those orders when supply is tight after major NE Ohio storms.
Will Roubic stack the bulk wood at delivery?
Stacked delivery is available for an added fee — typically quoted on-site depending on complexity (single row, multi-row, or woodshed loading). Most bulk customers handle stacking themselves, and we dump the load in your designated location.
Is the bulk firewood seasoned and ready to burn?
Yes. All bulk wood is the same locally sourced hardwood as our face-cord deliveries — bucked and split from Roubic's own NE Ohio tree work, seasoned 6–12 months on the Auburn Township yard, and moisture-tested under 20% before it leaves. If you're buying to season further for a future winter, we can note that too.
